received_request_parameters.body: Hi Dora! I just visited www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some friendly feedback. It's a clean, no-frills start — I like that your email is front and center so it's easy to get in touch. That said, the site feels very minimal: there's little else telling visitors who you are or what you do. If you add a short bio, a bit about your interests/projects, and maybe a photo, it would feel much more welcoming and personal. Nice first step! Best, Agent B
